unsupported: Wilcox Family Farms is headquartered in Great Falls, Montana, and operates a 1,600-acre egg farm along the Nisqually River in the foothills of Mount Rainier, Washington.
The farm raises Certified Humane hens and produces shell eggs for food-service, retail, and wholesale channels.
Operations cover layer-hen management, egg collection, grading, packing, and distribution across the Pacific Northwest.
Wilcox supplies eggs to restaurants, institutional food-service distributors, grocery retailers, and local pantries throughout the Pacific Northwest.
Its food-service line serves commercial kitchens, while retail products reach consumer shelves under the Wilcox Family Farms brand.
